verdict.rationale: Belvo's evidence covers its own aggregation, Pix payment initiation, direct debit and smart collections. Nothing documents processor integrations or a token exchange that passes verified linked-account credentials to third-party payment processors or platforms. Belvo's first-party payment products are an adjacent capability, not the hand-off to external processors this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, linked accounts plug into my payment processor — documented integrations or token exchange that hand verified account credentials to third-party processors and platforms
